transcript: Incident Postmortem: Checkout Outage — Attendees: Elena (Engineering Manager), Ravi (SRE), Hugo (Database Administrator)
Elena: Checkout was down for 40 minutes on Tuesday. What happened?
Ravi: The database connection pool was exhausted by a slow query on the orders table.
Hugo: The query was doing a full table scan. I'll add an index to the orders table on customer_id.
Ravi: I'll set up an alert on database connection pool usage so we catch this earlier.
Ravi: I'll also write up the postmortem document by Thursday.
Elena: Thanks. I'll share a summary of the incident with leadership.
Hugo: Our runbook didn't cover this case at all.
Elena: Right, someone should update the runbook. Let's not assign it yet.
Elena: Okay, thanks everyone.

action_items.text: Add an index to the orders table on customer_id
Set up an alert on database connection pool usage
Write the postmortem document by Thursday
Share a summary of the incident with leadership
Update the runbook
